skills.purpose: Control the phone via claw.device: Termux:API and adb (tap, shell, install, screenshot). Use when touching the phone.
Android, Termux, Termux:X11, Proot, ADB, shared storage, audio or bootstrap work; operator approves state changes.
Drive the phone's Chrome via claw.browser (CDP): read pages, click, type, snapshots, logged-in sites.
Call Gemini or OpenRouter models via claw.infer. Use for a second opinion, cross-model checks and bulk drafting.
Read Drive, Gmail and Calendar for either Google account via claw.device or rclone. Use when a task needs Google data.
Set up, add or re-authorize a Google account for claw-mcp. Use on no credentials, Insufficient Permission, bad token.
Operate the phone screen via claw.device: observe, act once, verify; stop at login or payment. Use to drive apps.
Termux on-device AI stack: llamad, aesopd bridge, termux-services, wake-lock, voice, NPU/HTP. Use for Termux work.
